title: Agents
subtitle: Give an agent a task and read what it did

empty.noConfiguredText: Create an agent to get started with autonomous AI workflows.
empty.browseHub: Don't know where to start? Browse the <1>Agent Hub</1> to find ready-made agent configurations you can import.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Agent
deleteDialog.message: Delete agent "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

strip.label: Last {{count}} runs: {{done}} finished, {{failed}} failed
strip.none: No runs recorded in this browser

record.where: Runs are recorded in this browser while you watch them. The server keeps no run history, so another browser starts with an empty record.

agent.taskPlaceholder: Describe the task. For example: find two good sources on speculative decoding and summarise them.
agent.taskHint: Enter starts the run, Shift+Enter adds a line
agent.pausedNote: This agent is paused, so it cannot start a run.
agent.noRunsText: Describe a task above and press Start run. The run keeps its own address, and its report stays here.
agent.clearMessage: Remove the runs of "{{name}}" that this browser keeps, including chats the earlier agent chat page stored here? The agent and its server-side activity are not touched.
agent.missingText: It may have been deleted or renamed, or it belongs to another user.

run.statusTitle: Opens the agent's status in a new tab, so this run stays open
run.addressNote: This address opens in the browser that recorded the run. Another browser shows a notice, because the server keeps no run record.
run.noStepsReport: The agent answered without calling a tool.
run.reportWorking: The agent is still working on this.
run.cutOff: This run was cut off before the agent answered. The page that watched it was closed, or the connection dropped.
run.noAnswer: No answer was recorded for this run. The page was closed before the agent answered, or the answer did not arrive.
run.stoppedLine: Stopped before an answer was recorded
run.dockWorking: The agent is working. Follow-ups open when it answers.
run.reconnecting: Connection to the agent lost. Reconnecting.
run.followUpPlaceholder: Ask a follow-up, or add to this result
run.followUpPlaceholderStopped: Give it a new task, or ask about the last one
run.followUpHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
run.failText: The agent reported an error and did not finish the task. Running it again starts a new run with the same task.
run.failSendTitle: The task did not reach the agent
run.failSendText: The server did not accept the task, so the agent never started. Running it again sends it once more.
run.evidenceNote: What the tools returned to the agent during this run, as the agent received it.
run.missingTitle: This run is not in this browser
run.missingText: Run {{id}} is not in this browser's record. Runs are kept where they were started, and the server keeps no run history, so a link from another browser or a cleared record cannot be opened.

create.subCreate: Fill in what you need. Sections you leave alone keep their defaults.
create.subEdit: Runs in progress keep working on the version they started with.
create.previewNew: The configuration this form will save.
create.previewEdit: The configuration this form will save, and how it differs from the saved agent.
create.configNote: Values that look like keys, tokens or passwords are hidden here. They are saved as typed.
create.noChanges: No changes. The form matches the saved agent.
create.allNew: A new agent: every value you set is new.
create.draftLabel: Describe the agent in one sentence
create.draftPlaceholder: For example: an agent that reads my release notes and lists breaking changes
create.draftNote: Optional. Asks the model you chose to write a name, a description and instructions. Nothing is saved until you save, and the draft may be wrong, so read it first.
create.draftNeedsModel: Pick a model in the Model section first. The draft is written by that model.
create.draftBad: The model did not return a configuration
create.drafted: Draft added. Read it before you save.

status.title: Status
status.lede: What {{name}} did, one record per action. A run's report says what came of a task. This page is the raw record behind it.
status.emptyText: Give the agent a task and its actions show up here.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.stopMessage: Stop every job that is running or waiting? Finished jobs stay in the history.

summary.quiet: No runs in the last 7 days.

tasks.title: Tasks, {{count}}
tasks.caption: Tasks
tasks.deleteMessage: Delete the task "{{name}}"? Its jobs stay in the history.
tasks.undoMessage: Task "{{name}}" deleted. Nothing is removed until this closes.
tasks.deleteAbandoned: Nothing was deleted, because the page was closed first.

history.title: Run history
history.caption: Run history
history.emptyText: A run starts when you press Run now on a task, when a schedule fires, or when the API starts one.

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.text: A task is a prompt a model runs for you, on a schedule or whenever you start it.
empty.step1: Write the prompt. Use {{gap}} where a value changes from run to run.
empty.step2: Pick a model that has MCP tools, so the task can do more than answer.
empty.step3: Give it a schedule, or press Run now.

wizard.noModelsText: Jobs need at least one model with MCP (Model Context Protocol) support. Install a model first, then add MCP in the model settings.
wizard.noMcpText: You have models, but none has MCP turned on. Jobs use MCP to reach tools and outside services. Edit a model to add MCP servers.

run.title: Run {{name}} now
run.desc: Give the prompt the values it uses. A schedule uses the parameters saved with the task.
run.noGaps: This prompt has no gaps to fill.
run.more: More parameters, one key=value per line
run.mediaHint: Attach files to send with this run.

cron.monthly: On day {{day}} of every month at {{time}}
cron.zone: Times follow the clock of the machine that runs LocalAI.

errors.fields: Use five fields: minute, hour, day, month, weekday. You wrote {{count}}.
errors.descriptor: Use @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly or @every followed by a time such as 5m.

task.noRuns: This task has not run yet.
task.promptNote: Values in colour are filled in when the task runs: from the schedule, or from the person who starts it.
task.noScheduleText: This task has no schedule. It runs when you start it, or when the API does.

edit.subNew: Name it, write the prompt and choose when it runs.
edit.subEdit: Changes apply from the next run.
edit.name: Task name
edit.descriptionPlaceholder: One line on what this task does
edit.enabledHint: A task that is off keeps its schedule but does not run on it.
edit.promptPlaceholder: Write a summary about {{topic}} in {{format}} format.
edit.promptHint: Use {{gap}} where a value changes from run to run. The values come from the schedule, or from the person who starts the task.
edit.cronHint: Minute, hour, day, month, weekday. For example 0 */6 * * * runs every six hours.
edit.scheduleParamsHint: These values fill the prompt when the schedule starts the task.
edit.gapNoValue: The prompt uses {{names}}, but the schedule does not set a value for it. A scheduled run would send the text unfilled.
edit.mediaNote: A scheduled run fetches these before it starts.
edit.webhooksNote: Called when a job ends, whether it worked or not.
edit.previewEdit: What the next run would send, and what differs from the saved task.
edit.previewNew: What the first run would send.
edit.promptAsSent: The prompt as a scheduled run would send it
edit.noChanges: Nothing differs from the saved task.

job.title: {{task}}, {{when}}
job.notFoundText: It may have been removed from the history.
job.againFailed: Could not start a new run: {{message}}
job.taskNote: The prompt as this run sent it.
job.taskNoteParams_one: The prompt as this run sent it. {{count}} parameter.
job.taskNoteParams_other: The prompt as this run sent it. {{count}} parameters.
job.taskUnknown: The task is gone, so the prompt is not shown. The parameters this run used are listed below.
job.outcomeWorking: This job is still running. The page checks again every two seconds.
job.outcomeWaiting: This job is waiting to start. The page checks again every two seconds.
job.outcomeCancelled: This job was cancelled before it finished.
job.outcomeNone: The job finished and returned no output.
job.failText: The task did not finish, so nothing was produced. Run it again to try once more, or open the task to change what it does.
job.failNoMessage: The job gave no error message.
job.traceNote_one: {{count}} entry. Open one for what it holds.
job.traceNote_other: {{count}} entries. Open one for what each holds.
job.noTrace: The server recorded no steps for this job.
